question: I forgot my password.
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page to reset your password. If your username/password is incorrect or failing, check for typos. If locked, your account auto-unlocks after 15 minutes. Note: Mobile logins are not supported; please use a desktop computer.

question: I can't log in.
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page to reset your password. If your username/password is incorrect or failing, check for typos. If locked, your account auto-unlocks after 15 minutes. Note: Mobile logins are not supported; please use a desktop computer.

question: What are the exam rules?
answer: For detailed exam rules, guidelines, browser requirements, and hardware setups, please navigate to our official [Explore FAQ Page](/faq). Key rules include: no external tabs, no copy-pasting, and active camera proctoring.

question: When does my exam start?
answer: You can view your exam schedule on your dashboard under the "Upcoming Exams" section.

question: How much time is available for the exam?
answer: The exam duration is displayed before you start the assessment and the timer will be visible throughout the exam.

question: Camera is not working.
answer: Please allow camera permission in your browser settings and refresh the page. Ensure no other application is using your webcam.

question: Microphone is not working.
answer: Allow microphone permission in your browser settings and reconnect your microphone if necessary.

question: Which browser should I use?
answer: We recommend using the latest version of Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge for the best experience.

question: Can I refresh the exam page?
answer: Yes, you can refresh the page. Your answers will be automatically saved if the auto-save feature is enabled.

question: My internet disconnected.
answer: Reconnect to the internet as soon as possible. Once connected, reopen the exam portal. Your saved answers will be restored automatically if supported.

question: I cannot submit my exam.
answer: Ensure all required questions are completed and check your internet connection. If the issue continues, contact technical support immediately.

question: Can I change my answers?
answer: Yes, you can modify your answers until you click the final Submit button.

question: How do I submit the exam?
answer: Click the "Submit Exam" button and confirm your submission. After submission, changes cannot be made.

question: When will results be published?
answer: Results will be available on your dashboard after the evaluation process is completed.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Use the Contact Support page or email support@example.com for technical assistance.

answer: You're welcome! Best of luck with your assessment. Feel free to ask if you need any more help.
